lines.zh: 我踩着碎步，腰布是红的
lines.en: I trot on quick feet, my loincloth red.
The red strip flutters behind me.
I hurry along the base of the wall.
A pack of us crowds the alley.
I step over broken pottery.
My shadow on the wall is short.
I drag a sack by one corner.
I hop down the steps.
I slap my own thigh as I run.
I step on a dry stick and it snaps.

lines.zh: 巷口的门半掩着，我钻过去
lines.en: The alley door is ajar; I slip through.
I switch the sack to my other hand.
I splash through a dirty puddle.

lines.zh: 我在巷子里拐了两个弯
lines.en: I turn twice in the alley.
I push off the wall for speed.
I run beneath a window.

lines.zh: 我的红布缠到腿上，我扯开
lines.en: My red cloth wraps my leg; I pull it free.
I shout back over my shoulder.
I sit on the step swinging my legs.
My red loincloth bunches at my knees.

lines.zh: 我啃着一块硬得咬不动的东西
lines.en: I gnaw something too hard to bite.

lines.zh: 旁边两个在抢一根骨头
lines.en: Two nearby fight over a bone.

lines.zh: 我蹲在墙根，挠着后颈的癣。
lines.en: I squat by the wall, scratching the mange on my neck.
A line of light leaks through the roof.

lines.zh: 我把袋子倒过来抖了抖
lines.en: I upend the sack and shake it.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，露出小牙
lines.en: I yawn, showing small teeth.
I tie the sack's mouth tight.

lines.zh: 墙根有一排在晒太阳的
lines.en: A row of them suns themselves at the wall.

lines.zh: 我用牙咬着布条的一端
lines.en: I hold one end of the strip in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我把脚趾头在土里埋着
lines.en: I bury my toes in the dirt.

lines.zh: 巷子那头有人在喊名字
lines.en: Someone at the alley's end calls a name.
I fold my arms over my chest.
I count the bricks in the wall.
I press an ear to the wall and listen.
I raise my face and look at your shoes first.

lines.zh: 你这么高，一定很有东西
lines.en: So tall, you must have things.

lines.zh: 我的红布在暗处也看得见
lines.en: My red shows even in shadow.
I put my hands behind my back.
I bare my teeth; it is not a smile.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就往门那边偏
lines.en: You move and I lean toward the door.

lines.zh: 我小声跟旁边那个说了句
lines.en: I mutter something to the one beside me.
I tip my face up; my neck aches.

lines.zh: 我的手指在腰布上捏紧
lines.en: My fingers tighten on my loincloth.

lines.zh: 你站在巷口，把光挡住了
lines.en: You stand in the alley mouth, blocking the light.
I glance at the door beside me.

lines.zh: 我发出一点低低的声音
lines.en: I make a low little sound.
I yelp sharply and roll aside.
I clutch my shoulder, teeth clenched.

lines.zh: 我的红布上多了块深色
lines.en: A dark patch spreads on my red cloth.
I lie flat, ears trembling.
I wheeze like a leaky bellows.
I curl up and roll to the wall.
My teeth knock together.
I hug the sack to my chest.
I retreat in little hops.
I press into the shadow at the wall's foot.
That is the smell of meat.

lines.zh: 红腰布蹭到你的腿，我闻闻。
lines.en: My red loincloth brushes your leg as I sniff.
There are crumbs still in my mouth.
I will not snatch; loosen your grip first.

lines.zh: 我们几个都看着你的手
lines.en: All of us are watching your hands.

lines.zh: 给了我们，我们就不跟着你
lines.en: Give it and we will stop following you.

lines.zh: 我把腰布的一角卷起来
lines.en: I roll a corner of my loincloth.
I extend a hand a little.
I swallow, and it is loud.
This would feed four of us.
I push the one beside me back.
I take one small bite to test.
Raise your hand and I cannot reach.
I hold my sack up to catch it.
I will not make a fuss; I will just wait.

lines.zh: 你把东西分均匀，我们就走
lines.en: Divide it evenly and we will go.

lines.zh: 我撞在你小腿上，弹回去
lines.en: I hit your calf and bounce back.

lines.zh: 我的红布被你的鞋踩住
lines.en: Your shoe pins my red cloth.
I pull, and the cloth tears.
The one beside me collides too.
The two of us are thrown back together.
Your foot moves and we all scatter.
I hit the door frame and rebound.

lines.zh: 我们两个一起撞上你的腿
lines.en: The two of us strike your leg together.
I am squeezed against the wall's foot.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的红布另一头
lines.en: You pin the other end of my red cloth.
I slip back between your legs.
We knock over a basin between us.
Her loincloth is a deeper red.

lines.zh: 我们把袋子放在两个人中间
lines.en: We set the sack between us.
She holds the tear in my cloth.
We sit back to back at the wall's foot.

lines.zh: 她比我矮一点，跑得比我快
lines.en: She is a little shorter, and faster.

lines.zh: 我们说好谁也不许偷吃
lines.en: We agree that neither may eat secretly.

lines.zh: 她把我的红布重新系好
lines.en: She reties my red cloth.
We squat side by side waiting for dark.
Her hands are dirtier than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起数今天抢到的东西
lines.en: We count today's takings together.
I squat and scoop it together.
I pick up even the crumbs.

lines.zh: 地上的东西归先看见的
lines.en: What falls belongs to whoever sees it first.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进腰布的褶里
lines.en: I tuck it into a fold of my loincloth.
The one beside me reaches; I slap the hand away.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西我不敢拿太久
lines.en: I dare not hold what I find too long.
I gather it with my foot.
I bend and my red cloth nearly slips.
I blow the dust off two copper coins.

lines.zh: 我把它揣在腰布里，藏好
lines.en: I tuck it well into my loincloth.
I back up until my heel hits the wall.
I show my teeth, and my feet shake.

lines.zh: 我们几个把路堵了一半
lines.en: We block half the road between us.

lines.zh: 我喊了一声，巷子里有回音
lines.en: I shout, and the alley answers.
I will not fight you; I will wear you down.
I show all my teeth.

lines.zh: 我们几个慢慢往两边分
lines.en: We slowly spread to both sides.
I lift a stone.

lines.zh: 巷子只有一个口，我堵在这边
lines.en: The alley has one mouth; I block this side.
I strike first, then run.

lines.zh: 我从一个人家的门洞钻过去
lines.en: I slip through a doorway.

lines.zh: 你转过来，我就蹲在桶后
lines.en: You turn; I crouch behind a barrel.
I keep following without closing in.
We split to both sides.
I watch you while backing away.

lines.zh: 我蹲在门后，看得见你的脚
lines.en: I crouch behind the door and see your feet.
You come forward; I go back.
We stay at your left and right.
I shift the stone between hands.

lines.zh: 我踩到一块松砖，没出声
lines.en: I step on a loose brick without a sound.
I leap and claw at your belt.

lines.zh: 我腰上这条红布，是战利品。
lines.en: This red cloth at my waist is a trophy.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖口往后扯
lines.en: I bite your cuff and pull back.
I strike and scatter, then come again.
I smash the stone on your foot.
I lunge and bite your trouser leg.
I butt the back of your knee.
I fling a fistful of dirt in your face.
I strike and scatter; you cannot catch us.
My teeth are small, but I am desperate.

lines.zh: 我从巷子的一头跑进来
lines.en: I run in from one end of the alley.

lines.zh: 我的红布在门框上蹭了一下
lines.en: My red cloth scrapes the door frame.
Two more follow behind.
I check the way out first.
I squat on the threshold, waiting.
I come running from the alley's end.
I still clutch half a cake.
Two packmates stop with me.
I put my back to the wall.

lines.zh: 我先看有没有大个子在
lines.en: I check first whether a big one is about.

lines.zh: 火顺着我的红布烧上来
lines.en: Fire climbs my red cloth.

lines.zh: 我从柴堆上掉下来，摔在土里
lines.en: I fall off the woodpile into the dirt.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我拼命蹬
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I kick hard.
The blast throws me into a gap in the wall.

lines.zh: 一支箭把我的耳朵擦破了
lines.en: An arrow cuts my ear open.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我手脚都不听话
lines.en: That force makes my limbs disobey.

lines.zh: 饿了两天，我蹲都蹲不稳
lines.en: Two days hungry and I cannot even squat straight.
Lightning strikes the alley mouth and I press to the wall.

lines.zh: 街上没有地了，我掉下去
lines.en: The street has no floor; I drop.
